facts.text: "Rule one, no killing anybody. Rule two, you can eat the quesadillas. Come on, Terminator."
facts.why: John never says this. It is in quote marks and signed John Connor, so it reads as a film line. His famous rule is that the Terminator cannot go around killing people. The wording below is a line from the quote page I opened.
facts.fix: Now don't take this the wrong way, but you are a Terminator, right?

facts.text: Salceda's place. Guns in the ground, beer in the esky.
facts.why: The plot page I read lists Enrique Salceda as Sarah's friend but does not describe a camp scene, and notes a survivalist camp scene was cut from the theatrical plot. I could not confirm the camp, the buried guns or the beer. The same goes for 'Enrique's camp, before Sarah digs up the guns' and the Enrique dish names.
facts.fix: Cyberdyne's lobby kiosk, before the lab raid

vibe.verdict: The biker bar and mall cues are right, but the beach kiosk weather strip has nothing to do with the film.
missing: Come with me if you want to live (the Galleria mall)
Hasta la vista, baby (the Terminator and John)
The T-1000 arm blade and the police cap (the mall and the hospital)
John's dirt bike through the canal with the tow truck (the chase)
Sarah's chin ups and the checkered floor (Pescadero hospital)
The thumbs up in the molten steel (the finale)
ideas: Swap the weather strip for a Cyberdyne style readout, 'System: Online, Model 101'.
Swap the made up John note for a real John line.
Swap 'Ice cold Mexican lager with lime' for 'Biker bar lager, borrowed along with the clothes'.
